items.title: Target and Lowe's earnings, Fed meeting minutes: What to Watch
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come tomorrow, Wednesday, August 19, including earnings from major retailers TJX (TJX), Lowe's (LOW), and Target (TGT), alongside the minutes from the Federal Reserve's most recent FOMC meeting.

items.title: Target and Home Depot take center stage as investors size up consumers
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Opening Bid panel focuses on the Sector of the Day: Retail, as Home Depot (HD) and Target (TGT) report earnings this week. Meanwhile, the 30-year Treasury yield climbs to levels not seen since 2007, giving investors another key read on the strength of the consumer.

items.title: Home Depot, Klarna Q2 earnings shed light on strength of the consumer
items.summary: Retailer Home Depot (HD) and buy now, pay later service Klarna (KLAR) both released their second quarter earnings results on Tuesday, helping shed some additional light on the health of the US consumer. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley and Barron's associate editor Al Root to cover what this all signifies about the ongoing strength of consumers.
